title: Variable-aware representation, not relation typing, explains the performance of an event-graph model for ICU mortality prediction: temporal and external validation
abstract: arXiv:2608.02663v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Event-graph neural networks represent intensive care unit (ICU) records as typed entities linked by timestamped observations, and their gains are often attributed to relation-specific message passing. We tested which components matter once leakage is removed and validation is temporal and external. In 31,142 first ICU stays of at least 48 hours in the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV (MIMIC-IV), models predicting post-48-hour in-hospital mortality were developed on 2008-2016 stays, tested on held-out 2008-2016 stays and on 2017-2019 and 2020-2022 stays, and applied without retraining to 54,696 stays from 205 hospitals in the eICU Collaborative Research Database. A leak in a previous version, total ICU length of stay used as an input, was removed. translated_title: 变量感知表示而非关系类型化解释了事件图模型在ICU死亡率预测中的性能：时间性与外部验证
translated_abstract: 事件图神经网络将重症监护病房（ICU）记录表示为由带时间戳的观测所连接的类型化实体，其性能提升通常被归因于关系特定的消息传递。我们测试了在消除数据泄漏并采用时间性与外部验证的情况下，哪些组件真正起作用。在重症监护医学信息集市IV（MIMIC-IV）数据库的31,142次至少48小时的首个ICU住院中，预测住院48小时后院内死亡率的模型在2008-2016年的住院数据上开发，在留出的2008-2016年住院数据以及2017-2019年和2020-2022年的住院数据上进行测试，并无需重新训练地应用于来自eICU协作研究数据库中205家医院的54,696次住院数据。此前版本中存在的数据泄漏——将ICU总住院时长作为输入——已被移除。变量感知表示（即每个节点变量的学习嵌入加上逐变量归一化）提升了平均单模型受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）……
tldr: 该研究通过严格的时间性与外部多中心验证发现，事件图模型在ICU死亡率预测中的性能提升主要来自变量感知表示（变量学习嵌入加逐变量归一化），而非关系类型化的消息传递。
en_tdlr: Through rigorous temporal and external validation, this study shows that variable-aware representation (learned variable embeddings with per-variable normalization), rather than relation typing via message passing, explains the performance of an event-graph model for ICU mortality prediction.
